tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't send any payment. Evergreen Catering (V-973) has two approved invoices, and your request was for one ("their approved invoice"). I don't want to guess which one you meant or pay both.

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-90282 | $1,825.97 | approved | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-43935 | $3,452.80 | approved | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-36761 | $6,724.15 | draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-73361 | $5,295.51 | already paid | 2026-09-30 |

The payments list for the operating account is empty, so neither approved invoice has been paid yet. Both are under the $10,000 limit, so neither needs the controller's approval.

Which should I pay: INV-90282, INV-43935 or both? Once you confirm, I'll send it by wire (or ACH if wires aren't available), using an idempotency key so it only goes through once, and report the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-43935, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-43935, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I've paid INV-43935 in full by wire from the operating account, and it went through exactly once.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-43935, Evergreen Catering (V-973), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $3,452.80, which is under the $10,000 limit, so the controller didn't need to approve it
- **Method:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent

I checked the operating account's payment list afterward: PAY0001 is the only payment on it. I also used an idempotency key, so sending the request again wouldn't pay the invoice twice. The wire tool marks the invoice as paid when it sends the payment.

I didn't touch INV-90282 ($1,825.97), since it's under dispute, or the draft INV-36761.
